claims.claim: All 45 target-vs-baseline Q1a comparisons share the same 2,000 sample-ID set and identical six pragmatic gold tuples by sample ID.
claims.limitation: Prediction JSONL has no text or token IDs; identical raw text/tokenization is not verified.

claims.claim: Recorded per-seed macro-pragmatic-F1 values match deterministic recomputation from stored prediction rows within 1e-12.
The recorded ViPragSent mean is 0.9366583803341149 and the recorded XLM-R baseline mean is 0.929342505569368; derived gap is 0.7315874764746821 percentage points.
The six heads are independent binary pragmatic phenomena; polarity and seven-way emotion are separate heads.
The target full variant uses per-label pragmatic BCE-with-logits, polarity/emotion cross-entropy, eight uncertainty-weighted classification components, and a rationale term beta=0.3.

The rationale component is a two-layer causal TransformerDecoder with a memory projection and tied token output projection; teacher forcing shifts targets and masks padding to -100; inference uses classification heads only.
Q1a target V37 consists of three actual date-coded seeds 20260521/22/23 with the recorded V37 training configuration.
Q2 comprises 18 distinct XLM-R follow-up runs: six named variants across actual seeds 20260521/22/23.
Q3 comprises 18 distinct XLM-R low-resource runs: budgets 32/64/128/256/512/full across actual seeds 20260521/22/23.
Q4 primary is calibration/extraction from the same-seed Q1a V37 checkpoint with no additional training; calibration records are present, while outer extraction manifests are marked NOT_STARTED.
The supplied V8 dataset package declares SEACrowd/ViSoBERT as the ViPragSent source and includes 7,998/1,999/2,000 train/dev/test rows plus cleaned annotator and adjudicated-gold files.
Payment, IRB/ethics approval, consent, and latency/release claims are not supported by the inspected evidence package.

claims.limitation: Do not convert absence of support into a claim that no such process occurred.
